name: automode
description: AutoMode for Claude Code picks the model and the effort for each prompt, sets a risk floor, forces an Opus review on risky work, and checks whether a model switch is worth the cache rewrite. No key, no server.

mode.title: AutoMode: Router mode
mode.description: default: follow config.json (auto as shipped). auto routes model and effort in every session. shadow only records what it would route. off does not route. AUTOMODE_ROUTER still wins.

policy.title: AutoMode: Routing policy
policy.description: default: follow config.json. auto: the effortless judges with the joint optimizer. legacy: the earlier rules. Applies while the mode is auto. AUTOMODE_POLICY still wins.

completionGate.title: AutoMode: Completion gate
completionGate.description: default: follow config.json. report records whether the work showed its stated results. block also sends the model back, once per task, when that evidence is missing. off turns it off.

learning.title: AutoMode: Route learning
learning.description: default: follow config.json. on: a kind of task that needed rescue here starts on Opus next time. off: nothing is learned. Local to this machine and project, with no prompt text.

delegation.title: AutoMode: Delegated reads
delegation.description: default: follow config.json. off: reads run as usual. shadow: records what the gate would stop. on: a full read of a large file stops once, with an outline and a cheap extract tool. Takes effect in the next session.

executor.title: AutoMode: Executor
executor.description: default: follow config.json. judge: the judges pick the model. sonnet: Sonnet runs the task, and a pin, a floor or a repeated failure can still move it. The judges' pick is logged and changes nothing.

strongStep.title: AutoMode: Strong evidence step
strongStep.description: default: follow config.json. model: strong failure evidence moves to the stronger model (an Opus consult first). effort-first: it raises effort on the running model once per failure, unless a critical-risk floor needs the model.

consult.title: AutoMode: Opus consult
consult.description: default: follow config.json. always: the first strong failure on the way to Opus asks a read-only Opus architect before the session moves. priced: it asks only when the consult, with its retries and the cache it may lose, costs less than moving the session.

packet.title: AutoMode: Consult packet
packet.description: default: follow config.json. basic: the consult gets the goal, the criteria, the last failure and the edited files. rich: it also gets each fact's source, the person's later messages, the diff, every failing check and what was tried. fork-gated: rich, and a same-model fork fills what only the conversation holds when that costs little next to the consult.

forkRung.title: AutoMode: Fork diagnosis rung
forkRung.description: default: follow config.json. on: before the Opus consult, the main model starts a fork agent. The fork shares the conversation and its warm cache, and it diagnoses the failure without editing. A repeat after it goes on to the consult.

strategy.title: AutoMode: execution strategy
strategy.description: default: follow config.json. legacy: the current routing and rescue ladder. v6a: Haiku only for T0 or bounded T1 work, else Sonnet high; recovery raises effort, and a model moves only while the context is small. v6b: v6a with Sonnet at the judged effort on standard work. v6c: v6b, and a fresh rescue builder replaces a model switch on a large context. Experimental: see bench/experiments/V6.md.

start.title: AutoMode: start route
start.description: default: follow the strategy. legacy: the current start route. v6a: Haiku only for T0 or bounded T1 work, else Sonnet high. v6b: v6a with Sonnet at the judged effort on standard work.

recovery.title: AutoMode: recovery
recovery.description: default: follow the strategy. legacy: the rescue ladder with its model switch. hold: never move a large context; a switch only while the context is small or cold. rescue: hold, plus a fresh builder on the same model, then one model up, priced against a switch.

review.title: AutoMode: review rule
review.description: default: follow the strategy. prospective: a judge's risk rating can require a review. observed: only critical risk the diff shows does.

builder.title: AutoMode: builder subagent from the start
builder.description: default: follow config.json. on: non-trivial work goes to one builder subagent at the routed model from the start. Experimental.

haikuFirst.title: AutoMode: Haiku first on T3 work
haikuFirst.description: default: follow config.json. t3: with opusStart evidence, T3 work without critical risk may start on Haiku, and failure evidence moves it up. off: Haiku takes T0 to T2 work only. Off by default: in the v4 and v5 proof runs, t3 cost more than Sonnet high.

opusStart.title: AutoMode: Opus at the start
opusStart.description: default: follow config.json. evidence: T3 work starts on Sonnet high, and Opus comes only from failure evidence (a failing check, a regression, a reviewer blocker). judge: a T3 rating with critical risk or an Opus need starts on Opus.

routeModels.title: AutoMode: Route models
routeModels.description: default: follow config.json. off routes effort only and keeps the model you picked.

subagentsEverySession.title: AutoMode: Subagents in every session
subagentsEverySession.description: default: follow config.json. on: built-in subagents are routed in every session, not only AutoMode (Explore on Haiku; general-purpose on Sonnet under Opus). An explicit model is always kept.

guardianMode.title: AutoMode: Guardian
guardianMode.description: default: follow config.json (auto as shipped). observe records only; recommend adds notes; assist adds checkpoints and one-key suggestions; auto may also pause, compact and shorten outputs where those are on. AUTOMODE_GUARDIAN still wins.

guardianEverySession.title: AutoMode: Guardian in every session
guardianEverySession.description: default: follow config.json. on: the guardian runs in every session, not only AutoMode.

hardPause.title: AutoMode: Hard pause
hardPause.description: default: follow config.json. on, in guardian auto: a turn that does not converge is ended between requests, never mid-write.

autoCompact.title: AutoMode: Auto compact
autoCompact.description: default: follow config.json. on, in guardian auto: compacts between turns when it pays; otherwise /compact is suggested.

reduceOutputs.title: AutoMode: Reduce long outputs
reduceOutputs.description: default: follow config.json. on, in guardian auto: long command output is saved in full and shortened in the chat, every error line kept.

layout.title: AutoMode: Layout
layout.description: expanded: the status bar above the prompt. minimal: one short line.

theme.title: AutoMode: Theme
theme.description: native (default): follows your Claude Code and editor theme, with no colours of its own. automode: blue routing, violet effort, teal guardian. mono: neutral accents. contrast: stronger text and edges.

appearance.title: AutoMode: Appearance
appearance.description: auto follows your Claude Code theme. dark and light fix it.

metrics.title: AutoMode: Bar metrics
metrics.description: Comma-separated bar items: pending, context, cache, cost, guardian, stage. The mode, model and effort always show.
